cards.name: Generic Collection Domain Definition

cards.oracle_text: Draw cards equal to the greatest mana value among permanents you control.

cards.name: Generic Collection Land Return
cards.oracle_text: Return target land to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Generic Collection Pair Definition
cards.oracle_text: Generic Collection Pair Definition's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in all graveyards and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.

cards.name: Generic Collection Self Modifier
cards.oracle_text: This creature gets +1/+1 for each basic land type among lands you control.

cards.name: Generic Collection Domain Tokens
